evidence: With input 0060, the length slice data[2:4] is empty and int.from_bytes returns zero. The code then returns an IE with an empty value instead of rejecting the incomplete header.

test_case.test_condition: The input ends after the two-octet IE type and contains neither octet of the required length field.
test_case.expected_behavior: Reject the input as a truncated IE header before interpreting a length or returning an IE value.

bug_root_cause: The initial boundary check verifies only that the two-octet IE type is present. It does not require the complete four-octet IE header before reading the length field.
